message.content: {"note_claim": "The video shows people retrieving gifts from a climbable Christmas tree in Cairo's Mall of Arabia, not Muslims vandalizing a tree in a town square.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the depicted trees were \"climbable\" and observed that the \"angry Muslims\" were actually revelers who wore Christmas hats, appeared to be in good spirits, and were retrieving gifts placed at the top of the tree for kids to find", "reason": "The Snopes page says the viral clip shows a Cairo Mall of Arabia climbable tree with people retrieving gifts, not an attack, though it dates the video to 2015-2016 rather than 2019."}
